risks.title: Managed Care Contracting and Rate Risk
risks.summary: Material reductions in contracted rates from managed care payers or difficulty collecting could materially adversely affect operating results
risks.score_rationale: Approximately 70% of net patient service revenue dependent on managed care contracts; inability to maintain competitive rates or collect from managed care payers could materially adversely affect results of operations (Item 1A)

risks.title: Healthcare Regulatory and Legislative Changes
risks.summary: Changes in healthcare laws and regulations, particularly OBBBA provisions affecting Medicaid funding and coverage, could materially impact revenues
risks.score_rationale: Industry subject to significant legislative and regulatory uncertainty; changes in federal and state healthcare laws, funding policies or reimbursement practices could have material impact on future revenues and expenses (Item 1A, MDA)

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.summary: Ongoing healthcare sector consolidation and increased competition could negatively impact market share and financial performance
risks.score_rationale: Healthcare sector consolidation continues; increased competition could impact market share and operating results (Item 1A)

risks.title: Labor Shortage and Wage Inflation
risks.summary: Shortage of qualified healthcare personnel and wage inflation continue to increase labor costs and operational expenses
risks.score_rationale: Healthcare labor market remains tight with significant wage inflation; staffing challenges impact operating costs and service delivery (Item 1A, MDA)

risks.title: Medical Supply Cost Inflation
risks.summary: Medical supply price inflation continues to pressure operating margins and operational costs
risks.score_rationale: Medical supply prices remain elevated despite moderation in general inflation; continued pressure on operating expenses (MDA)

risks.title: Union Activity and Labor Relations
risks.summary: Increased union activity and labor organizing efforts could increase costs and affect operations
risks.score_rationale: Increased union organizing activity could impact labor costs and operational continuity (Item 1A)

risks.title: Government Program Dependency
risks.summary: Substantial dependency on government healthcare programs; regulatory changes affecting Medicaid and Medicare could materially reduce revenues
risks.score_rationale: Significant portion of revenues from Medicare, Medicaid and other government programs; changes to government reimbursement rates or eligibility could materially impact financial results (Item 1A)

risks.title: Reputation and Operational Risks
risks.summary: Reputational and operational risks in healthcare service delivery could negatively impact patient volumes and financial performance
risks.score_rationale: Healthcare provider reputation risks related to quality, safety and patient outcomes; operational disruptions could impact financial performance (Item 1A)

ai_positioning.summary: Tenet Healthcare does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.
